exposure: Women with vs. without placenta accreta (surgical and/or pathologic diagnosis)
Immediate CH vs. attempted placental separation
cohort: 99 women with suspected placenta accreta at a tertiary care center from 2002 to 2012
finding: An intra-operative cesarean hysterectomy decision strategy for suspected placenta accreta cases allowed some women to avoid cesarean hysterectomy without increasing blood transfusion or post-operative complications, but was associated with a higher rate of cystotomy.
mod_finding: The study examined the frequency of cesarean hysterectomy (CH) and postoperative morbidities in suspected placenta accreta (PA) cases when an intra-operative decision strategy for CH was used.
